title: Sky3D
summary: Day/night cycle for 3D scenes: a sky shader with sun, moon, stars, clouds and fog, sun and moon lights driven by game time, and exposure controls.
useWhen: A 3D game needs a sky that changes with the time of day, such as sunrise, noon, sunset and a starry night, with sunlight, shadows and ambient light that follow it, or a game clock with day and night.
avoidWhen: A fixed sky is enough: Godot's ProceduralSkyMaterial or PhysicalSkyMaterial in a WorldEnvironment needs no add-on.
